_why: Hand-counted from the six steps in make_fixture.py, which is where the
numbers were chosen — not read back out of the parser. Steps 0-4 are LLM
requests; step 5 has no ModelUsageStats and must produce no record, so
records is 5 and not 6.
(ModelUsageStats field 2: the UNCACHED remainder, which
is what this column means. Total prompt would be this
plus cache_read_tokens, and is computed at render time.)
cache_read_tokens  24679 + 50000 = 74679
(steps 0, 3 and 4 have no field 5 at all, so they
contribute nothing rather than contributing 0)
(field 3 is the output TOTAL. Steps 0, 1, 3 and 4 also
carry its split across fields 9 and 10 -- 459+83,
and 20. Summing 3, 9 and 10 would double-count output.)
cache_write_5m     null, and cache_write_1h null
(ModelUsageStats field 4 IS cache_write_tokens, but
Antigravity never writes it: absent in all 11,795 real
requests checked. null means unmeasured; 0 would claim
the cache writes were measured and free.)
The counters are unaffected by model resolution, which is the point of
checking them here: steps 0 and 1 share enum 1020 but resolve to different
efforts, and steps 3 and 4 resolve to no registry id at all, yet every
token still lands in the same totals.
